An aquatic '''mermaid-like species''' lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Several members of this [[Species/Legends|species]] once performed as dancers at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Auto" />
